    Large orthogonal families of Kronecker bricks #

    For a well-order α of regular uncountable type with |k| ≤ |α|, the transports of the rigid map system of α with an extra one-point marker form |α| pairwise orthogonal bricks of dimension |α|. With the anchor T_{Λ_{Y₀}} and the non-split classes through the copy of T_{Λ₀} they form an anchored family (Bricks.transportPool). This plays the role of the rigid κ-families of Göbel–May (Proposition 4.2) in the singular case.
